title: Collections
wikitext:
The '''Collections''' tab acts like a record of which items have been discovered or [[Shipping|shipped]] and in what quantities.  

==Items Shipped==
This tab keeps track of the type and amount of specific items [[Shipping|shipped]] via the [[Shipping Bin]] on [[The Farm]], or via the [[Mini-Shipping Bin]].
{{Collections Items Shipped}}

==Fish==
This tab keeps track of the type and number of [[Fish]] caught with either a [[Tools#Fishing Poles|fishing pole]] or a [[Crab Pot]]. Entries are added upon catching the fish. The fish does not need to be shipped to count towards the collection. 

Fish obtained in other ways (''e.g.'' by [[Foraging]], purchasing from [[Krobus]] or the [[Traveling Cart]], dropped by [[monsters]]) do '''not''' count towards the Fish Collection.
{{Collections Fish}}

==Artifacts==
This tab keeps track of the type and amount of [[Artifacts]] collected. Artifacts are added to the collection tab when donated to the [[Museum]]. Their names and descriptions will ''not'' appear until they are donated.
{{Collections Artifacts}}

==Minerals==
This tab keeps track of the type and amount of [[Minerals]] collected. Minerals are added to the collection tab when donated to the [[Museum]]. Their names and descriptions will ''not'' appear until they are donated.
{{Collections Minerals}}

==Cooking==
This tab keeps track of the type and amount of dishes the player has "[[Cooking|cooked]]" in the Farmhouse kitchen. Dishes do not need to be shipped to count towards the collection. Dishes for which the recipe is known but have not yet been cooked appear greyed-out. Dishes with unknown recipes show "???".
{{Collections Cooking}}
